name: Veritaas Advertising Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2018, Veritaas Advertising 
Ltd is a marketing and advertising agency[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) VAL is in the business of consultancy of advertising, publicity, public relations, press relations and mass communication in consumer market, industrial, sociological and advertising research, graphic designing including product packaging exhibition, designing, photography, photo type setting computerised desktop publish printing, lithowork and manufacturing advertising objects, novelties, packaging and other advertising materials 
b) It is in the business of advertisement  and publicity agents and contractors including outdoor and in door, digital, newspapers and magazines, books, screens, slides, walls, buses, railways, other transport vehicles and public places, audio visual display 
c) Company prepares, advice, manufactures 
and constructs advertising devices and to 
publish or advertise the same through any 
media whatsoever

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 33.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
